# Ingram Micro to Host 2026 Capital Markets Day on September 15, 2026 – Registration Now Open


August 24, 2026 3:30am PDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_7692bddcbe152d9543866633269fbe44/ingrammicro/news/2026-08-24_Ingram_Micro_to_Host_2026_Capital_Markets_Day_on_970.pdf)


IRVINE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Ingram Micro Holding Corporation (NYSE: INGM) ("Ingram Micro" or the "Company") today announced that registration is open for its 2026 Capital Markets Day, to be held Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at NYSE Texas in Dallas.


The event will feature presentations from Ingram Micro’s executive leadership team, including Chief Executive Officer Paul Bay, Chief Financial Officer Mike Zilis, and Executive Vice President and President, Global Platform Group Sanjib Sahoo. Leaders will discuss the Company’s strategy, the continued evolution of its AI-powered Xvantage™ platform, opportunities across the global B2B technology ecosystem, and the Company’s longer-term financial model.


"As technology complexity increases, Ingram Micro is uniquely positioned to simplify the ecosystem and unlock growth for our partners, vendors and shareholders," said Paul Bay, Chief Executive Officer of Ingram Micro. "At Capital Markets Day, we will outline how our strategy, our AI-powered Xvantage platform, and our disciplined financial model support sustainable growth and long-term value creation."


**Event Details**


A live webcast and presentation materials will be available at the start of the event at[https://ir.ingrammicro.com/events-presentations/events](https://ir.ingrammicro.com/events-presentations/events) . A replay will be available following the event. Institutional investors and sell-side analysts interested in attending in person should emailir@ingrammicro.com to request a registration link.


**About Ingram Micro**


Ingram Micro is a leading technology company in the global information technology ecosystem. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to a highly diversified base of business-to-business technology experts. Through Ingram Micro Xvantage™, our AI-powered digital platform, we offer what we believe to be the industry’s first comprehensive business-to-consumer-like experience, integrating hardware and cloud subscriptions, personalized recommendations, instant pricing, order tracking, and billing automation. We also provide various technology services, including financing, specialized marketing, lifecycle management, and technical pre- and post-sales professional support. Learn more at[www.ingrammicro.com](http://www.ingrammicro.com/) .
